current_exact_source_findings: TurnAffinity cache recreates Responses ids from completion_text instead of replaying the exact rendered response.
Foreground account reservation and TurnAffinity memory cache are updated before ConversationSegmentStore persistence.
ConversationSegmentStore persistence errors are swallowed by _save_locked and only set persistence_blocked.
responses_payload creates response/item/call ids only after provider state/cache/reservation persistence steps.
stream_openai_responses emits response.created and request-local reasoning rs_* before durable publication and later inserts that reasoning item into response.completed.
Account pool status exposes configured accounts[].id, allowing stale persisted owner validation without provider traffic.
v12_required_order: build one canonical Responses payload with final response_id/item_id/call_id
strict atomic ConversationSegmentStore publication of progress + canonical payload
validate persisted owner against current account_pool status and restore/clear foreground reservation
only then project canonical payload to JSON or SSE
new_v12_guard: After any strict persistence failure, the durable store must fail closed before a retry can call the provider again. Otherwise the first failed publication can be followed by a second provider plan even though the store is already persistence_blocked.
not_proven: native PowerShell runtime restore replace semantics
live Codex compatibility of delayed SSE first identity-bearing event
